title: UPI Transaction Limit Per Day in 2026: Bank-Wise UPI Daily Limit
summary: Check the latest UPI transaction limit per day, bank-wise UPI payment limits, daily transfer caps, monthly limits, and maximum UPI transactions allowed in 2026.
body_markdown:
Table of Contents


Toggle


Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has transformed how people and businesses make digital payments in India. But UPI transactions are subject to limits set by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), banks, and, in some cases, the UPI app you use.


For most regular UPI transactions, the standard limit is **up to ₹1 lakh per transaction** . However, your actual daily or monthly transaction capacity may be lower depending on your bank, account, transaction type, and applicable bank-level restrictions.


UPI transaction limit can be categorised as:


1. **General UPI transaction limits**


- Daily Limit: ₹1 lakh per day
- Per Transaction Limit (UPI 123Pay): ₹10,000
- Transaction Count Limit: Maximum 20 transactions per day


2. **Higher UPI transfer limits: Upto ₹5 lakh**


- Tax Payments
- Payments to Educational Institutions & Hospitals
- IPO Applications
- Payments to RBI’s Retail Direct Schemes


3. **UPI limits in specific sectors**


- Capital Markets, Foreign Remittances, and Insurance – ₹5 lakh daily limit
- Education & Healthcare (Verified Merchants) – ₹5 lakh daily limit


4. **Bank specific UPI limits**


- UPI transfer limits **vary between banks** . While most banks offer limits between ₹25,000 to ₹1 lakh per day, some may impose **weekly or monthly caps** instead of daily limits.


##


UPI Transaction Limit Per Day


The UPI transaction limit per day has been defined by each bank in the UPI network and varies from bank to bank. For example, the SBI UPI transaction limit per day is Rs 1,00,000.


##


UPI Transaction Limit Per Week


Some banks have also defined how much amount can be transferred through UPI in a week. For example, the IDFC UPI limit per week is Rs 1,00,000.


##


UPI Transaction Limit Per Month


Limited public sector banks and recognised private banks have imposed a UPI transaction limit per month. For example, IDFC bank’s UPI transaction limit per month is Rs 30,00,000, while SBI has not set any limit.

##


PhonePe’s Daily UPI Limit Per Day


- The PhonePe transaction limit per day is 1 lakh INR (Rs. 1,00,000)
- In terms of frequency, the Phonepe limit per day is 20 transactions in 24 hours


Check out this blog to get more information on the[PhonePe transaction limit per day](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/phonepe-transaction-limit-per-day/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=upi-transaction-limit) .


##


SBI UPI Transaction Limit Per Day


- The SBI UPI limit on a single transaction is a maximum of Rs 100,000 as determined by NPCI
- Per day UPI transaction limit of SBI is also Rs 100,000, whether done through a single transfer or multiple transactions up to a maximum of 10 transfers
- There is no limit for per week or per month value of the UPI transfer


##


UPI Limit of ICICI bank


- ICICI limit per transaction is Rs 10,000
- ICICI per day UPI transaction limit is Rs 10,000
- There is no limit for per week or per month value of the UPI transfer
